verdict.rationale: Stripe's own versioning docs describe monthly API releases that contain only backward-compatible changes and can be adopted safely, and event destinations offer versioned snapshot events. The story's other half, a documented deprecation policy, does not appear anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: an explicit deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, documentation of how breaking (major) versions are handled and pinned, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Each monthly release includes only backward-compatible changes... You can safely upgrade to a new monthly release without breaking any existing code.
